comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by universities; doesn't operate institutions or collect tuition directly, so the model differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit nursing and allied health colleges funded by tuition and student aid, matching Rasmussen, though smaller and regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: For-profit online and campus university operator serving adult students, Title IV-funded tuition, with a health sciences school.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults, with employer and military tuition channels; same tuition model.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual schools funded by public per-pupil funding; different customers and funding from postsecondary adult education.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: For-profit postsecondary career school operator earning tuition from Title IV and GI Bill funding; vocational, but a similar model.
